items.title: AI music can be difficult to detect, but there are some telltale signs
items.excerpt: Engadget's guide to spotting AI-generated tracks: what to listen for in vocals, lyrics and instrumentals, plus quick ways to check whether an artist is real.

items.title: Weakening AI copyright law will spell 'disaster for creativity', global music body warns Albanese
items.excerpt: Exclusive: IFPI's chief tells Australia's government that opening online content to AI training would be a 'huge mistake' that damages the country's reputation. (Off-list; no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: Spotify's AI remix tool draws backlash from listeners
items.excerpt: Spotify is reportedly weighing a $4-$5 monthly add-on for AI covers and remixes; some subscribers say they will cancel. Follow-up to the 11-02 report. (Off-list.)

items.title: 조영수 오래된 노래, 버추얼 가수 '원'의 숨으로 피어나다 [인터뷰]
items.excerpt: Hitmaker composer Cho Young-soo launches his first AI virtual artist WON, debuting Nov 8 with single 'Mama Song'; he says 'if AI scores 99, the last 1% is the human's part' and targets the Billboard chart. (Korean AI music launch; off-list.)

items.title: The new Ivors Composer Awards is pushing back against AI
items.excerpt: With AI threatening composers' rights and livelihoods, the Ivors Academy's new Composer Awards aims to raise the profile of human screen and media composers. (Off-list.)

items.title: AI tracks are flooding streaming, and almost nobody is listening
items.excerpt: Ninety thousand AI tracks hit Deezer every day, yet they draw only 1-3% of plays; editorial on the AI flood and what it means for electronic artists. (Off-list editorial.)

items.title: The Edge asked AI to come up with a U2 song: "They couldn't" says guitarist
items.excerpt: The Edge says U2 tested AI songwriting and it could not write a U2 song, though it handles strictly codified genres like country; songwriting is 'never a formula'.

items.title: Logic Pro 13 splits drum stems into kit pieces and rebuilds the browser
items.excerpt: Logic Pro 13 is now out as a free update: Stem Splitter separates drums into kick, snare, hats, toms and cymbals, with a unified tagged browser, Play Surface and iPad control; the AI assistant is Creator Studio-only (beta). Public release after the 10-28 beta coverage. (Off-list; on-list outlets only covered the 10-28 announcement.)

items.title: How IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley Is Tackling AI & Streaming Fraud Head-On: 'We've Got Work to Do'
items.excerpt: IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley talks AI, streaming fraud and the 'collaborative process' she feels is needed to solve the industry's most pressing issues.

items.title: Latent Terrain: Adapting Neural Audio Autoencoders as Design Materials in NIME
items.excerpt: A Max/MSP tool package that turns neural audio autoencoder latent spaces into corpus-based, navigable sound spaces for new musical instruments: neural synthesis as a design material.

items.title: CrowdForge: Effects of Audio and Visual Audience Participation Modalities on Agency, Collaboration, and Engagement in AI-Mediated MR Performances
items.excerpt: An AI- and mixed-reality-mediated live performance system where audiences collectively steer generative music and virtual environments in real time; studies how audio vs visual participation shapes agency and engagement.

items.title: How Close to the Theme? Similarity-Label Conditioning for Game Music Generation
items.excerpt: Fine-tunes a pretrained MIDI model on Super Mario section pairs so composers can dial how similar newly generated sections are to a theme, from near-repeat to new material.
